module: Central registry of BeamNG missions. It discovers file missions (folders /gameplay/missions/<level>/<type>/.../info.json) and procedural missions (generators in the proceduralMissionGenerators folder), loads them, sanitizes them, builds the mission object with its type's constructor (/gameplay/missionTypes/<type>/constructor.lua), loads the progress save, and provides the missions' POIs for the map. A modder uses it to list, find, create or save missions.
usage:
local m = gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionById('west_coast_usa/timeTrial/xyz')
for _, mi in ipairs(gameplay_missions_missions.getMissionsOfLevel('gridmap_v2')) do print(mi.id, mi.missionType) end
notes: A mission's id is the folder path minus the /gameplay/missions/ prefix. The part before the first "/" must be a known level (case-insensitive comparison), otherwise the mission is ignored with a warning. The path must not contain spaces.
getAllMissions loads all missions of all levels on the first call (expensive); getMissionsOfLevel / getMissionById load only what is requested. getAllMissions also fills the per-level cache.
A mission type is a folder /gameplay/missionTypes/<type>/ containing constructor.lua (required), and optionally editor.lua, progressSetup.json, staticData.json, preview.jpg.
A mission-specific constructor.lua (<mission folder>/constructor.lua) can merge its keys (except init) into the mission object.

sanitizeMissionAfterCreation replaces missing methods (onStart, onUpdate, onStop, stateChanged, getCommonSettingsData, etc.) with nop, computes the star cache (careerSetup._activeStarCache) and adds the mod info (modID, modName, modTitle).
The tables returned by getMissionById / getAllMissions are cached and shared: do not modify them without clearCache.
Probable bug in createMission: `table.insert(loaded, data)` adds the data table as a positional element of the loaded mission (the intent was probably to merge it).

In constructMissionFromFileData, `infoPath` is computed with the module's local variable missionDir (the string "/gameplay/missions") and not the mission folder: the path shown in the "did not specify a valid missionType" error message is therefore wrong.
getAllIdsOfLevel exists locally but is not exported.
M.editorHelper actually returns the editor/util/editorElementHelper class (with the 'mission' parameter), not the file missionTypes/editorHelper.lua.

dependencies.desc: Extensions loaded beforehand: gameplay_missions_startTrigger, gameplay_missions_progress, gameplay_rawPois.

onModManagerReady.desc: Alias of clearCache: the registry is cleared when the mod manager is ready (hook). Static analysis typed it as "any".

getRecommendedAttributesList.desc: List of possible recommended attributes for a mission: durability, offroading, rock crawling, acceleration, top speed, nimble.

getAdditionalAttributes.desc: Returns the displayable additional attributes (vehicle: own/provided/choice/multi/none; difficulty: veryLow to veryHigh) with icon and translation keys.

returns.desc: Table key -> {valuesSorted, valuesByKey, icon, label, translationKey}.

getMissionTypes.desc: Lists the mission types (names of the /gameplay/missionTypes folders containing constructor.lua). Result cached.

getMissionTypeConstructor.desc: Loads (require) and caches the constructor of a mission type. Logs an error and returns nil if the file is not found.

getMissionProgressSetupData.desc: Reads and caches progressSetup.json of the mission type ({} if it does not exist or is unreadable).

getMissionStaticData.desc: Reads and caches staticData.json of the mission type ({} by default).

getMissionEditorForType.desc: Returns the mission editor of the type (require of <type>/editor.lua then call). If it does not exist, creates a default editor based on editorHelper. Used by logMissionIssues and by the editor.

getMissionPreviewFilepath.desc: Looks for preview.jpg/png/jpeg in the mission folder, then in the mission type folder; otherwise returns the default preview.

sanitizeMissionAfterCreation.desc: Completes the mission after construction: official, date, mod info, default map icon (mission_primary_triangle), active star cache, rewards (rewardAmount nil -> 0 with an error logged) and default methods (nop) or default hints.

recursiveRemoveNestedFromCondition.desc: Recursively cleans a condition: converts an old branchId of a branchLevel condition to the new format (career_branches.oldAttributeNamesToNewNames) and removes "nested" from conditions that are not multiAnd/multiOr (warning).

getMissionTypeFromMissionId.desc: Extracts the mission type from an id: the second path segment (after the level), or an empty string.

loadMission.desc: Loads a mission from its folder (info.json) without cache: checks that the folder is under /gameplay/missions/ and has no spaces, sets id and missionFolder, sanitizes the data. This is the raw data, not the constructed mission object.

skipThumbnail.desc: true to not resolve the thumbnail.

returns.desc: Mission data, or nil on error.

saveMission.desc: Writes info.json (indented) for the mission data: name, description, missionType, retryBehaviour, startCondition, visibleCondition, startTrigger, missionTypeData, careerSetup (without _activeStarCache, with the original rewards restored), setupModules, etc.

getFilesData.desc: Returns the raw data (sanitized info.json, or procedural missions) of all missions, sorted by id, with a separate cache depending on skipThumbnail.

skipThumbnail.desc: true for a lighter list without thumbnails.

createMission.desc: Creates and saves a new mission in /gameplay/missions/<id> with default values (flowgraph type, level-type startTrigger on gridmap, vehicleDriven startCondition), then reloads it and adds it to the caches.

getMissionById.desc: Returns the constructed mission object for an id (with cache), or nil if it does not exist or its construction fails.

infoData.desc: Already-known info {dir|data, level, procedural} to avoid the lookup.

getMissionsOfLevel.desc: Returns all constructed missions of a level, sorted by id (with cache).

getAllMissions.desc: Returns all missions of all levels, sorted by id. Expensive on the first call (loads everything); updates the progress of util_asyncBulkLoader if it is active.

areAllMissionsLoaded.desc: Indicates whether getAllMissions has already been run.

returns.desc: true if the full list is cached.

getAllIds.desc: Returns the ids of all missions (without loading them), sorted.

getMissionsByMissionType.desc: Filters all missions by their missionType.

getMissionsByFilter.desc: Filters all missions by level (startTrigger.level) and/or by missionType.

getLocations.desc: Returns (with cache) the start zones of a mission via gameplay_missions_startTrigger.parseMission, adding mission and name.

returns.desc: Locations {type, level, pos, rot, radius, check, displayMarker, mission, name}.

existsMission.desc: Tests whether a mission exists without loading it (valid level and id present in the level's info list).

formatMissionToRawPoi.desc: Adds to `elements` one POI per "coordinates" start zone of the mission in the given level, if the mission is startable and visible (gameplay_missions_unlocks). The id is the mission id, suffixed with -<i> if there are several zones.

onGetRawPoiListForLevel.desc: POI system hook: adds the POIs of all missions of the level (current level if nil).

onActivityAcceptGatherData.desc: Hook called when the player opens an activity's acceptance window: for each "mission" type POI, adds a card (title, stars, additional attributes, "see details" button that opens mission.details).

logMissionIssues.desc: Computes (only once) then logs the list of configuration issues of a mission, via its type's editor (checkContainer and calculateMissionIssues). Severities: unknown, minor, warning, error, critical.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Loads (require) all generators from the proceduralMissionGenerators folder; those without generate get nop.

reloadCompleteMissionSystem.desc: Immediately stops the current mission, clears the caches of gameplay_markerInteraction, unlocks and missions (development tool).

clearCache.desc: Clears all registry caches (missions, file data, locations, available levels): missions will be reread on next access.

baseMission.desc: Shortcut to the missionTypes/baseMission factory: to be used in the constructor.lua of a simple mission type.

flowMission.desc: Shortcut to the missionTypes/flowMission factory: to be used in the constructor.lua of a flowgraph mission type.

editorHelper.desc: Shortcut to the editor/util/editorElementHelper factory preconfigured with the 'mission' context; used to write the editor of a mission type.
